name: BusinessProcessWorkflow
title: Business Process Workflow (DAK)
description: Logical Model for representing Generic Business Processes and Workflows from a DAK. A business process is a set of related activities or tasks performed together to achieve the objectives of the health programme area.

element.definition: Logical Model for representing Generic Business Processes and Workflows from a DAK. A business process is a set of related activities or tasks performed together to achieve the objectives of the health programme area.
An identifier for the business process workflow
Description of the business process - either Markdown content or a URI to a Markdown file (absolute or relative to repository root)
Link to a BPMN file containing the workflow definition. Source URI could be absolute or relative to the root of the DAK
References to user scenario IDs related to this workflow
Description of the objectives of the workflow
Tasks within the business process workflow
